Comment:
>>266010629
>Ted's view of freedom is subjective
He defines it for you in ISAIF see >>265999979
>his view of technology of a grand evil
I don't believe he ever says "evil". In any case, he does not say this about technology but about the technoindustrial system. Obviously we are the proximate "cause" of the system. This still doesn't imply that we should be living like this. What is your point? Whether humans creep back towards another revolution is out of our hands. We can't control the course of the entirety of nature over any appreciable amount of time, so it is irrational to worry about this.
